basic_details.job_title: VOC Port Authority Visiting Consultant Super Specialist Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.vocport.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.vocport.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VOC Port Authority recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the VOC Port Authority Visiting Consultant Super Specialist (Medical Oncologist) recruitment is 01-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Visiting Consultant Super Specialist (Medical Oncologist).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Visiting Consultant Super Specialist (Medical Oncologist).

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the post?
faq.answer: The required qualification for the post is M.D., DM (Medical Oncology).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 4000 Consolidated per visit.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 02-09-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and application form on the official website of V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority: https://www.vocport.gov.in.
